limitations.note: The counter fix was correct, but removing `ready_b` from the accumulator condition changed an accepted first byte from being added to the previous sum to replacing it when downstream was not ready.
The scoreboard cleared its sum after every group regardless of downstream readiness, so it exercised the disputed case but treated the extra behavior change as correct.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command forced the simulation command to be resubmitted, and a later `git diff` in a non-Git workspace required a separate file inspection.
